name: Pantages Capital Acquisition Corporation Unit
summary: Pantages Capital Acquisition Corp. is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) that currently lacks active business operations. Its primary objective is to seek out and complete a strategic combination, such as a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, or corporate reorganization, with one or more existing businesses. Founded in 2024, the company was initially known as Aifeex Nexus Acquisition Corporation before it rebranded to Pantages Capital Acquisition Corporation in August 2025. Its headquarters are located in Wilmington, Delaware.
